Chiron sextile the South Node can bring an old coping skill, hard-earned perspective, former helper, or practical lesson back into reach. You may know how to handle the conversation because you once had to learn it the difficult way. Use the medicine. You are allowed to benefit from what the experience taught you without organizing the present around the pain that taught it.
